# Index fixtures

Real documents fetched from EDGAR on 2026-11-04 with `SEC_USER_AGENT="OpenMarket-Index/0.1 (+https://openmarket.systems)"`, trimmed as each line says. Nothing here is hand-typed; the figures are the filers'.

- `nport-0000035402-26-006778.xml`: NPORT-P `primary_doc.xml` of Fidelity Mt. Vernon Street Trust, Fidelity Equity Growth K6 Fund, report date 2026-08-31 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/707823/000003540226006778/primary_doc.xml). Trimmed: of 131 `invstOrSec` holdings, kept the first two others and the three Anthropic ones; everything outside `invstOrSecs` as filed.
- `nport-719608-000114554922024223.xml` and `nport-719608-000114554922028055.xml`: New Economy Fund's NPORT-P (filed 2022-04-27) and its NPORT-P/A (filed 2022-05-19) for report date 2022-02-28 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/719608/000114554922024223/primary_doc.xml, …/000114554922028055/primary_doc.xml). Trimmed the same way: the Epic Games holding and the first two others of 256.
- `efts-anthropic-nport-page.json`: the first page of EDGAR full-text search for `"Anthropic"` in NPORT-P filed 2024-01-01 to 2026-11-04 (https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=%22Anthropic%22&forms=NPORT-P&dateRange=custom&startdt=2024-01-01&enddt=2026-11-04). Trimmed: 5 of its 100 hits (both hits of one filing, and one from each of three other filers), `aggregations` removed; `total` as returned (926).
- `ncen-0000035402-26-000575.xml`: N-CEN of Fidelity Mt. Vernon Street Trust filed 2026-02-11 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/707823/000003540226000575/primary_doc.xml). Trimmed: of 7 funds, the first two, each reduced to its name, series and adviser and sub-adviser lists; the registrant section as filed.
- `submissions-CIK0000707823.json`: EDGAR's submissions index for CIK 707823 (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000707823.json). Trimmed: name, CIK and type, and 5 of its recent filings (the three newest and the two latest N-CEN), four of the arrays' fields.
- `form-d-0002136346-26-000001.xml`: Form D `primary_doc.xml` of Granada Anthropic SPV, a Series of Decile SPV, LLC, filed 2026-05-26 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2136346/000213634626000001/primary_doc.xml), fetched 2026-11-05. Not trimmed.
- `form-d-0001493152-24-009735.xml`: Form D `primary_doc.xml` of Figure AI Inc., filed 2024-03-13 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2014185/000149315224009735/primary_doc.xml), fetched 2026-11-05. Trimmed: of 9 related persons, the first two; everything else as filed.
